rules.statement: A father cannot make a gift to his minor son who is still subject to his power, but the practice in Ceylon is for parents to donate to their minor children. Acceptance is necessary to make a donation fully effectual, but as minors cannot accept it, their grandparent and parents, when not also the donors, may accept for them.
rules.supporting_quote: Though some Roman-Dutch Lawyers declare that a father cannot make a gift to his minor son who is still subject to his power, yet the practice in Ceylon is for parents to donate to their minor children. Acceptance is necessary to make a donation fully effectual, but as minors cannot accept it, their grandparent and parents, when not also the donors, may accept for them.
